ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER B

Letter B — Ball.

A bouncy blue ball for a bouncy letter. B starts ball, bath, bubbles and half the fun of the day — this card gives all of that a friendly face.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, trace it together — then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does B say?

“b — buh, a quick lip pop”

B makes a quick lip pop: buh, like the start of ball and bubble. Press your lips together, pop them open and there it is.

TRACE THE LETTER

Trace B b together.

Follow the numbers with a finger — on screen or on each other’s palms. The arrows show the way to go, the numbers show where to start, and a grown-up reads the little script below each card. Slow and wobbly is exactly right.

Trace the uppercase B

Start at 1 at the top, pull straight down to the bottom. Lift. Start at 2 at the top, curve out to the right, round the top bowl and back to the middle. Lift. Start at 3 at the middle, curve out and round the bottom bowl back to the bottom of the stem.

Trace the lowercase b

Start at 1 at the top, pull straight down past the bottom line. Lift. Start at 2 halfway down the stem, curve round the bowl to the right and back to the stem.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Ball bounce beat.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Bounce a ball back and forth in the garden or hallway.

  2. 02

    Say buh with every bounce — the sound lands on the floor and sticks.

  3. 03

    Finish with: B is for ball! Then let your child throw it to you.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
